metric: Queries Calcite can answer from a materialized view that KumoSQL rewrites over the view and proves equivalent; 39 of 39 'cannot' cases (and 8 disabled ones) are not rewritten. Supported subset: 83/129.
correctness: 0 wrong: every rewrite is proven by the prover and re-run against the original on random DuckDB databases (85 verified, 1 not runnable)
usefulness: 86 of 196 queries changed (83 expected, 3 in cases Calcite disables); 85 of 86 verified on random databases
held_out: 21/39 reusable (held-out quarter by case-id hash; 22 rewrites, 22 verified, 0 wrong); development 62/110, baseline (existing prover alone) 8/110
caveats: Calcite's noMat is not a proof that no rewrite exists, so a rewrite where Calcite says noMat would be checked, not penalised (none occurred). Developed on the development split; 29 cases use shapes the engine does not read (outer/UKFK joins, INTERSECT, CUBE/ROLLUP, FLOOR-TO). Adapted shared-model cases are scored separately (19/20 reusable, 9/9 cannot, 0 wrong).
